inspection.result: The canonical mark, dedicated tiny source, and wide composition were inspected visually at master scale, 16 pixel scale, and social-preview scale. The canonical mark is text-free, genuinely transparent, flat-filled, violet with one teal inset, and has a simple modular C/D silhouette with no cursor or grid detail. The wide composition uses that exact canonical mark, clean flat geometric workspace panels, generous margins, and no text, device frame, third-party mark, vignette, gradient, or texture.

logoMaster.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: canonical transparent square product mark for a desktop design application
Primary request: Design a genuinely flat-fill, original geometric emblem that suggests a C and D through two interlocking modular panels. Keep the silhouette extremely simple and small-size-safe: one bold violet outer form, one compact teal inset feature, and one clean negative-space cut. Use no cursor, no grid, no micro-details, and no literal typography.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background
Subject: one centered abstract emblem, no wordmark
Style/medium: crisp flat vector-like bitmap mark with hard edges, scalable branding geometry
Composition/framing: square 1:1 canvas, centered mark, generous transparent margin, unmistakable at icon size
Color palette: expressive violet dominant with exactly one small teal accent
Materials/textures: uniform solid fills only
Text (verbatim): none
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; flat fills only; no gradients; no shadows; no 3D; no texture; no cursor; no grid; no watermark; no mockup; no extra symbols; original design only; no resemblance to any existing logo
Avoid: literal letters, thin strokes, tiny details, multiple teal accents, decorative clutter, photographic rendering, glossy or beveled effects

socialPreviewMaster.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide 2:1 social-preview composition for a desktop design application
Input images: Image 1: canonical product mark reference; preserve its outer identity
Primary request: Build a wide flat-fill composition around the canonical mark, with the emblem as the focal feature and a restrained set of opaque geometric panels suggesting a local design workspace.
Scene/backdrop: one uniform deep violet flat field
Subject: the supplied canonical mark plus abstract charcoal and violet workspace panels
Style/medium: crisp flat vector-like bitmap branding composition, solid fills, clean geometry
Composition/framing: 2:1 landscape canvas, canonical mark on the left third, panels on the right two-thirds, ample breathing room, no edge cropping
Lighting/mood: calm, precise, creative, no lighting effects
Color palette: canonical violet and teal plus deep neutral panel fills
Materials/textures: flat opaque fills only
Text (verbatim): none
Constraints: preserve the supplied mark identity; no gradients; no vignette; no texture; no 3D; no shadows; no text; no watermark; no third-party marks; no device mockup; no browser chrome; no signatures
Avoid: emblem redraw, cursor or grid noise, fake interface labels, photographs, glossy effects, bevels, decorative clutter
